projects.name: Calming Earthy Sage Green Kitchen
projects.description: This kitchen, private from the rest of the first floor, offers a warm and awakening space to start your mornings. Between the light sage green cabinetry, to the rich dark floors and island stools, there's a color and material contrast that frames the space effectively, but doesn't go too overstated. The intricate, detailed wicker overhead light fixture offers some texture to the space. Beyond the prep and cooking surfaces, this space features a fine Taj Mahal counter-topped island, that offers a casual place to share a meal, or read your morning paper. Adjacent to the sliding doors, lays a compact desk area that allows space for opening up your computer, leaving your calendar, but avoiding clutter!

projects.name: In-Home Bar
projects.description: A classy, and refreshing twist on the "man-cave", this space offers a remarkable hosting experience. As we worked with the client, who had requested the sleek and subtle black finish; I was able to give the bar a breathe of space by incorporating mirrors into the liquor shelves. Below the liquor shelves you'll find a geometric backsplash which adds texture and contrast to the eye level surfaces of the space. Personally, I love the way that the warm, brushed brass hardware, bar foot rail, and countertop trim, compliments the clean black color palette of the space. In addition to the brushed brass, we incorporated an antique cash-register as a playful, but elegant nod to the whole vibe of the in-home bar.

projects.name: Multifunctional Laundry and Office
projects.description: Multifunctional Laundry and Office space. Layered rugs, plants, and granite with a repurposed vanity for a deep laundry sink bring outside colors inside. We cut a hole in the wall next to the sink to fit the washer and dryer into a handy safe saving space. We turned the closet next to the fireplace into an office cove with matching granite.

projects.name: Eclectic Master Bath Suite
projects.description: The red tub! Before we draw any water and dive into the story of the bathtub, I wanted to first paint the bigger picture of this project. The client was looking for a reasonable upgrade to their master bedroom's bathroom and dressing area–– without jumping into an intensive remodel. The client had an existing brilliant red tub from their family, which we slid into the bathroom and sported with polished brass hardware. Paired with a sleek, but effective modular storage cabinet, and an upgraded vanity area, this bathroom steps beyond it's utility and is now an inviting space to draw a warm bath and enjoy a good book or decompress after a long day. Moving into the dressing area, the red lounging chair compliments the beautiful bathtub, and the elevated stone surface in the dressing area worked perfectly to move in a mirror and plants. As your gaze follows the frame of the mirror, along the legs of the planter your eyes find a classic hardwood inspired wood dresser.

projects.name: Retirement Retreat
projects.description: My clients recently retired to Colorado from Minnesota, and came with almost nothing. It was their desire to start fresh. They had distinct drive to hire me to help create a new living space. It was their goal to have this house become a home that felt like it was truly theirs, because it was truly 'them.' They embraced natural elements and took a bit of a leap with more color than they had previously been comfortable with. They are thoroughly enjoying their home as a retreat, when they're not out and about enjoying recreation in beautiful Colorado!

projects.name: Retirement Retreat Master
projects.description: This Master suite is a part of the Retirement Retreat Portfolio. These clients moved here from the Midwest after retiring. They decided they wanted to purchase all new things for their master suite, with the exception of a dresser and the stunning artwork you see pictured above their newly repurposed dresser. I suggested that we re-purpose their dresser from a less than aesthetically desirable stain color and style, into something 'new.'  We 'brought it into' classic black with a little sheen, donned it with clear hardware, and placed it under their beautiful artwork. They love it, along with the natural elements, and earthy colors and textures. It was such a delight to work for these clients who loved bringing continuity into this space by bringing the outside in. It turned out to be a perfect blend of colors from our Colorado red rocks, scrub oaks, and beautiful mountains...and right outside their windows!

projects.name: Stunning Statements
projects.description: This lovely home sits on top of a mountain with no shortage of breathtaking views all around the property. It is filled with Rustic and Eclectic stone, tile, and wood. Due to the uniqueness of this home, we brought in stunning lighting from West Elm to help it's character stand out even more.  Adding more textures, plants, and leather mixed amidst different shades of pink, green and blue made this mountain top gem become a treasured haven for this very special family.

projects.name: Calming Sophistication
projects.description: This lovely Colorado Springs home located in the Rockrimmon area has received a complete transforming makeover. It went from dated colors and styles to beautiful shades of blush, ivory, blues, and soft pinks. It's transitional style pairs wonderfully with the newly acquired open concept for their living, dining and kitchen space.

projects.name: Mountain Master Makeover
projects.description: This lovely renovated mountain master bedroom received a full remodel of it's existing master bedroom and closet. It also received a completely new master bathroom (two room suite), and a new master walk in closet, complete with wallpaper on the ceiling. This entire space speaks bright and beautiful. The porcelain flooring was designed with two colors, weathered white and gray. The barn doors were made from wood that was shipped in from this client's family homestead in IL.  This space truly restored the old and embraced the new!

projects.name: Claire's Sanctuary
projects.description:
A lovely young girl's bedroom received a complete whimsical makeover. 
She enjoys Harry Potter, the colors pink and mauve, cats, and writing. 
Metallic antiqued wallpaper along with gold and white décor made this space come to life!

projects.name: Clean Living
projects.description: This beautiful new Colorado Springs home located in Cordera is full of natural light and beautiful wood floors. Soft dusty blues and plums paired with ivory and white make for a gorgeous clean and airy aesthetic.

projects.name: Kissing Camels Chalet
projects.description: This 1970's Kissing Camels Condo is full of beautiful original woodwork and parquet flooring. This client has chosen Roche Bobois pieces for almost every room in her home. This entry way was designed to feel both contemporary and warm. The original wrought iron railing paired with white walls and an ultra contemporary console make for an inviting entrance.

projects.name: Repurposed Eclectic Living
projects.description: This home is eclectically styled with pops of bold colors in rustic and modern styles with lots of texture. It is full of warmth, liveliness, and a lovely and active family!

projects.name: Eclectic Salon Waxafras
projects.description:
This salon, located in a large house in downtown Colorado Springs is full of character.  It's wood floors and vintage chairs paired with fun eclectic jungle wallpaper aside medium pink walls make for a truly unique waiting room. The bold colors of red orange and deep blue mixed with an antique chandelier make this esthetician's work space something different and full of life.
This space truly says, "Be bold, brave, and enjoy yourself and everyone you meet!"

projects.name: Mother in Law Suite
projects.description: This lovely new suite is a part of a new addition. We used her existing furniture and brought in new rugs, window treatments, mirrors, chair, bedding, and accents. The overall color palette is dusty pink, gray, ivory, and gray blue. It speaks of traditional graces.

projects.name: Eclectic Charm Living
projects.description: This lovely home came alive with a variety of colors, textures, patterns and unique pieces. One of my favorite things about this project was taking an old Dining room hutch and turning it into a home bar for this couple's living room where they often entertain friends and family.

projects.name: Branch Out Salon
projects.description: Rustic glam is what this space came alive through. The soft subtle tones with a pop of wallpaper and character-filled pieces provided this space the comfort and relaxation needed. The beautiful lighting brought in the glam for a lovely pairing.

projects.name: Modern Havana Living
projects.description: I decorated this home with consideration for this couple's love of Modern Havana,  entertaining, New York Yankees, Hollywood, and dogs! Each room has a unique part to play!

projects.name: Mini Makeover
projects.description: Global style makeover

projects.name: Spacious Living
projects.description: Bright and spacious living

projects.name: Sage's Ocean Escape
projects.description: Ocean Wallpaper Mural

projects.name: The Fog Lifted
projects.description:
This client hired us to surprise their 14 year old daughter with a room makeover for her Christmas gift. How fun this project was! Sylvie went with me to shop for accessories for her room and chose (if my memory serves me right) 14 candles! 
This room went from foggy to the fog lifting! It was truly a delight to see the transformation and hear what a respite it has been for Sylvie during covid-19.

reviews.name: Beth Blakney
reviews.body:
JanLee did a redecoration of our entire house and a remodel of the kitchen and the master bathroom to make it ADA accessible. I have many good things to say about JanLee and her staff. The three most important ones are:
* She has access to a myriad of contractors and she keeps those contractors on schedule. From window covering experts to painters to seamstresses to make custom pillows, she always knows who to ask and since she is such a good client, they will make room in their schedule for her projects.
* She runs the entire project so you don't have to. She can see from the beginning of a project what needs to be done and schedules it all. Her years of experience ensures she does not miss any crucial steps.
* She offers a current and fresh perspective of decorating and decor but also takes into account the client's personal tastes.
JanLee will do your project right.

reviews.name: Charles Roderick
reviews.body: I was looking to get a bar design and build. I found Janlee and everything fell into place. She had eye for design and her input was spot on. She worked endlessly on my project and finished on time. I was blown away of her vision she had. I waited 19 years for my bar she made my dream a reality. Thank you Jan. She was awesome and I would definitely use her again in the future.

reviews.name: Kathryn Davis
reviews.body: Jan has done multiple projects over the last 8 years. ALWAYS dependable and meticulous with great ideas. She's a joy to be around and highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.name: Adam Ryals
reviews.body: I requested a lot of stuff at a fairly tight budget, and got exactly what I wanted. Working with Janlee was a fantastic experience, and I would absolutely work with her again. Strongly recommended

reviews.name: Melissa and Joe Strike
reviews.body:
Amazing experience in all possible aspects with Janlee.

He communication
Her vision
Her talent
Her personality
Attention to detail
Making the process fun

We could never come close to this end result on our own. We ended up doing more stuff than we had initially planned but we are so glad we did. We continue to call on Janlee for all of our house projects. She did a major project for us in 2019 and some smaller stuff for us in 2022.

Six stars! :)

reviews.name: DW Knurr
reviews.body:
Dear Sirs, I have worked with Interiors By JanLee as a subcontractor for many years helping out with various aspects, of the fulfillment of her designs. I specialize in hanging wall art and light and hardware replacement. A job doesn't go by when I am not taken back by her creativity and vision to transform a house into a home of peace and beauty.
It's always a pleasure to work with Interiors By JanLee and to be a part of the process, which I have seen bring much pleasure and peace to those who have invested their hard earned resources to experience satisfaction for the investment that they have made.

reviews.name: Katie Davis
reviews.body: Jan has managed a number of projects in my home both large and small over the past 8 years. Whatever it is, her work is outstanding. She takes the time to understand your taste and preferences, gives attention to every detail, has great design ideas, works within your budget, and is always reliable. Aside from that, there is none else I would rather have in my home.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Janlee has done several interior design projects in my home, starting with a 2018 re-design of my teenage daughter’s bedroom, which she did with intuitive magic, collaboration and respect. And on budget! That experience revealed her to be a family planning partner and friend whom we’ve included at every step of our design journey. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Judy Felder
reviews.body: I recommend JanLee without hesitation. She quickly understood my style, goals and budget. She worked tirelessly to make our home beautiful while we were out of state. I found JanLee to be charming as well as efficient.

reviews.name: Kay Wood
reviews.body: I have known Janlee for many years, and have seen many of her designs brought to life and she is truly talented.

reviews.name: Cathie Barela O'Briens Carpet One
reviews.body:
I have been working with Janlee for many years helping her with the floors for some of her customers. She has excellent design sense and very creative. She is also a wonderful person and easy to work with. I have recommended her to my clients and friends many times.
I highly recommend Interiors By Janlee!

reviews.name: Debra and David Strike
reviews.body:
We wake up everyday and say I love my house. She works with you so when it is done it is YOUR house not a design in a furniture store. Love her work and highly recommend JanLee.
We could never have done this ourselves.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: We employed Janlee to help us pull together our home remodel. She advised us on paint color, flooring, fireplace design and directed us to local professionals for window treatments and area rugs. We are extremely pleased with how our home came together and how easily and smoothly it happened with the direction and support of Janlee. We highly recommend Janlee. She is an outstanding interior designer.

reviews.name: Sarah Larrabee
reviews.body:
I cannot recommend Janlee enough. She listened to my discombobulated rants, not being able to make a clear decision, and helped me change aspects of my house to make it exactly what I was looking for.
Hire Janlee. You will not regret it!

reviews.name: Jane Stark
reviews.body: There is only one word to describe JanLee: WOW! She is talented, creative, imaginative, hardworking, personable, patient, professional, and a genuinely kind and caring person. She and her husband/business partner, Wayne, went way above and beyond the call of duty to accommodate me with a guest bathroom remodel. Now, thanks to JanLee's talent and vision it is charming, warm, and elegant.. The entire project was completed in a timely manner, on budget and always with a smile. Thanks JanLee and Wayne. God bless you both.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: JanLee is incredibly observant and has a talent for getting the details right! She was able to quickly conceptualize a unique vision for our home that beautifully paired our desires with the elements that were already in our house. Her ability to honor our organizational needs, budget, style differences, concerns and schedule made her easy and enjoyable to work with. We found JanLee and her husband (jack of all trades) to be generous, caring, trust worthy and truly professional. They went the extra mile to ensure we were completely satisfied with their work and exceeded all of our expectations. We are so happy with the updates she made to our home and recommend hiring her!

reviews.name: Amy Badendick
reviews.body: Jan came into our shop and immediately seen a vision for color and design! We ran with it and it looks great! She is so wonderful to work with and she truly cares about your personal sense of style. It all comes together for a beautiful finished look! I can't wait to have her come and do my next home!

reviews.name: Dwell Moore
reviews.body: Janlee helped turned our master bed room from a mismatched, sad state, into a relaxing, peaceful retreat. She had excellent taste and helped us determine what we were really looking for (we had a hard time pinning that down).

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: I have know Jan for 25 years! First time I was in her home noticed she had painted flowers on the wall in her daughter's room!!! No one was doing that 25 years ago-it was precious! Recently my husband woke up and said "painting the den today, pick a color!" WHAT? Immediately texted Jan...sent pics of my den and the wall that the color needed to blend with and she suggested Repost Gray! It is beautiful! Then needed curtains and accents....she said "throw those pillows out and get these"....I would have never thought of that! And all the help was done from Colorado to Alabama! What a gift to be able to "SEE" a room from so far away! So very grateful!!

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Wonderful job, exactly what I was looking for. Very communicative and responsive. Highly professional and great to work with ,couldn't be more satisfied.

reviews.name: Melanie Ochoa
reviews.body: Jan is one of the most hard-working and sincere people to work with. I enjoyed my time helping her set up her branding and in the process was able to learn about how truly dedicated she is to her clients and work. She has a great relationship with every one of her clients and is always incredibly professional. Her attention to detail is uncanny and she has a natural ability to covert a space into a vibrant, beautiful piece of your home. Whether you're looking to redecorate your home or office space, hire Interiors By Janlee for the best customer service and I promise you will be heard and the desires for your space will become a reality. I would recommend working with Jan time and time again!

reviews.name: Josh Cuchiara
reviews.body: I have worked with Jan for a while now and I have nothing to say except WOW! Jan is absolutely the best. Not only does she take all of your personal needs and wants into all of her design process, but she will take your goals and turn them into art. Her color theory is unbelievable as well as her artistic eye. She absolutely understands that she is transforming the place where you must live every day... and then she makes sure that the place she is transforming is a place that you'll love to be in. I can't say enough about how professional and personal she really is... And as a fellow professional, I highly recommend working with her!

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Jan is a gifted interior-designer. She transformed our master bedroom from boring to beautiful. She had great ideas and helpful suggestions. She is very experienced and knowledgeable.

reviews.name: Sherri Vande Streek
reviews.body: Janlee consulted with me over the phone and through e-mail. She assisted me in finding a new sofa, pillows,an ottoman & accessories for my living room. She provided me with her designer discount through Wayfair, sent me numerous swatches of fabric and gave me the peace of mind of ordering a sofa online. ( I was very skeptical of purchasing a sofa online.) She also offered the option to travel to my home! (Wisconsin) I highly recommend Janlee

reviews.name: Katie Davis
reviews.body: Always professional, reliable, and talented. Jan and Wayne have completed several projects in my home and I would highly recommend Interiors by Janlee to anybody.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: I had he privilege of working with Jan and Wayne from Interiors by Janlee and I must say, it was the most professional but also personable experience for me. They take the time to really understand my taste, which made it easy for me to trust them. It took a huge weight off my shoulders. They did my living room and dining room. Wayne even hand made a beautiful mantel for my fireplace. These are people that, not only know their craft, but are also integrous, personable and a joy to work with. I would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: I must say that hiring Jan was one of my smartest decisions. I hired the company to decorate my small business. When all was said and done, I knew I wanted to have my house decorated as well. I love the little touches that was not expected. Jan listened to my every desire and made my vision come to life. I would most definitely recommend her services.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Jan helped me with two redecorating projects. Both turned out awesome! Jan and her work are remarkable, phenomenal, and exceptional. Her design ideas are unique and her color choices are creative. I highly recommend Interiors by Jan.

reviews.name: Amy Vanterpool
reviews.body: JanLee helped our family design my 12 year old daughter's room. Since we live in Montana, we did all of our communication through email. We sent photos and measurements of the room along with my daughter's favorite colors. We had a mural for the wall and needed assistance picking out furniture, drapes, and bedding to match the underwater mural. Jan Lee was very prompt with return emails along with sending photos of many items for my daughter to choose from (within her parents budget). Without a doubt, we would choose Jan Lee for our next project.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body:
Working with Interiors By JanLee was a most wonderful and satisfying time. I had my bedroom and master bath painted, wallpapered and wonderfully designed. Jan was patient with me and gave great recommendations as I made decisions about decor. My bedroom is beautiful and beautifully displays my personality and love for color.
After my bedroom was so perfect, I had my living room, dining room, and kitchen designed next. Absolutely stunning! My stair railing was painted an HGTV color called Peppercorn and I loved it so much that I had my kitchen cabinets painted the same color. Jan and her crew painted all my walls from the master bedroom to the living room/dining and the colors chosen along with the cabinets, has made our home a place of comfort and beauty. We have many compliments when guests come. The pictures on the walls, all the items of decor, reflect me and my love for color and beauty. 
Jan spent many hours searching for just the right item and always within my budget.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body:
We hired Janlee to update our bedroom - this included painting the walls & ceiling, selecting wall hangings, decor and new bedding. The painting was excellent and we were pleased with the design/decor. The room became a pleasant place to hang out.

Janlee worked very hard to give us choices and learn the things that were important to us. 

Job well done.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: I love my rooms again! I started to decorate my living room, dining room and foyer and totally got stuck. Janlee Interiors came in and took what I already had, added in lovely details, and created beautiful spaces I'm at home in and I feel proud of. Janlee used my personality to make my house a reflection of me. She took my traditional tastes and added the unexpected in tasteful, interesting ways that I would not have been able to do myself. She took the stress away from decorating! What a wonderful company - integrity, honesty, excellent taste, hard-working. Such a pleasure to work with!

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Janlee came to my business and home and discussed what I desired. She brought samples and then took additional time to bring in wallpaper. I tend not to do things "outside comfort zone." She discerned personality and then developed a decor. I actually have a room that I would never have done before meeting Janlee and absolutely love it.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body:
I've done quite a bit of work for Interiors By JanLee (IJL) and must say that there isn't a more dedicated and personable contractor around. If fact, I did a painting bid for IJL for a customer who was, by all standards, a manipulator. Despite this crazy woman's demeanor, JanLee handled herself as a professional with overwhelming grace. ( I might not have been so gracious.) 
We recently completed a kitchen and guest room remodel as well. The customer and the customer was more than thankful for the work done to her high-end retro town home.
As a contractor, I am happy with the integrity, attitude and character with which Interiors By JanLee consistently operates in and I recommend IJL highly.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: Best ever! I worked with multiple contracts to get work done but NEVER met anyone so honest, reliable and extremely affordable. I will never deal with anyone else. rare Gem for sure.

reviews.name: Houzz User
reviews.body: If you want someone that will transform your living space by taking your personal style to influence the design then Interiors By Janlee has done that for me. Using my budget they shopped and purchased items for my selection; reviewed color preferences for paint and accessories; and added a few surprises for my delight to create an atmosphere for my entertaining and relaxation needs. I had several special items I wanted incorporated into the design and I couldn't be happier with the arrangement . I wasn't sure what I needed and after my consultation I knew we had it figured out! With patience and Janlee's know how they shopped around and found the best deals. They updated the look of my rooms, from painting; changing light fixtures; adding wallpaper; window treatments; or simply rearranging the furniture and wall art. They were considerate of my needs; time and finances and provided me with a home décor I enjoy sharing with my family and friends... and that's exactly what I wanted!
